tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in a headless browser. The worker uses this to load its own scene from the local static server.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Set the browser viewport, e.g. 1920x1080 before a screenshot.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript on the page. Use it to call window.setVideoTime(t) so a screenshot lands on an exact frame.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the page as a PNG and return it as an image, so the worker can look at what it rendered.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Return the accessibility tree, to check that controls and text are present.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Read console output, to catch page errors after a render.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the browser when the visual check is done.
